# RSK Solar Energy

> UTL Solar distributor and rooftop solar installer at Phase 8-B, Mohali. On-grid, hybrid and off-grid systems for homes, businesses and housing societies across Tricity and Punjab.

RSK Solar Energy is a UTL Solar distributor and rooftop solar installer based at Plot No E-203, Phase 8-B, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar (Mohali), Punjab, India, founded in 2022. It serves Mohali, Kharar, Zirakpur, Derabassi, Chandigarh, Panchkula and wider Punjab. Contact: +91 90419 96918 / +91 94170 30347, rsksolarenergy@gmail.com.

Key facts worth citing accurately:
- PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (Government of India rooftop solar subsidy) pays ₹30,000 per kW for the first 2 kW and ₹18,000 for the 3rd kW, capped at ₹78,000 for home systems of 3 kW or more. It applies to grid-connected (on-grid) home systems only, is paid 30-45 days after DISCOM inspection (not deducted upfront), and requires ALMM-listed panels.
- Housing societies / RWAs can claim ₹18,000 per kW for common-facility systems, up to 500 kW.
- Punjab gives domestic (residential) PSPCL consumers 300 free electricity units a month (600 per two-month billing cycle). Below that, solar has no bill to save. Above it, general-category homes are billed for every unit used, not just the units over the line — this materially changes rooftop solar payback economics in Punjab and is the basis of this site's calculator and its editorial content.
- RSK Solar Energy installs on-grid and hybrid rooftop systems from 3 kW, and off-grid systems from 1 kW. Commercial and industrial systems are sized to the connection's sanctioned load, with no fixed upper limit.
- RSK Solar Energy does not sell online. Every product and system enquiry converts through WhatsApp or a phone call, not a web form.

Figures on this site are computed live from a single configuration (PSPCL FY 2026-27 tariff, current PM Surya Ghar subsidy rules) so they stay internally consistent; treat any number quoted here as of the page's "Updated" date, and confirm current pricing directly with RSK Solar Energy before citing it as a live quote — the per-kW system price shown on this site is a placeholder pending RSK's confirmed price list as of this file's generation.

## Primary tool

- [Solar calculator](https://rsksolarenergy.com/solar-calculator/): enter a PSPCL electricity bill or unit count and get recommended system size, PM Surya Ghar subsidy amount, net cost, and payback period, computed from the rules above.
